_comment: SKTB: the model IS the parameters, so this input needs no data files and runs as written. Graphene, one pz orbital per carbon, a single -2.7 eV pp_pi hopping out to 1.6 A (first neighbours only). Each carbon has three neighbours at 1.42 A, so the Gamma-point eigenvalues are +-3|t| = +-8.1 eV and the reported spectral window is that padded by 0.5 eV.

structure._comment: The conventional two-atom basis. The second carbon sits at fractional (-1/3, 2/3) -- outside the cell -- which is fine: coordinates are used exactly as written and periodic images are expressed against them.
